# Project instructions

This repository defines a shared AI development workflow for Codex and GitHub Copilot.

- Read `docs/ai-development-workflow-package-spec.md` before making changes.
- Read the relevant GitHub Issue and existing files before proposing implementation.
- Do not start implementation when asked to create an implementation plan.
- Keep the Codex and Copilot adapters aligned with the common workflow and artifact contracts.
- Do not export company-specific policies, detailed test logs, execution history, or secrets to the common master.
- Stop and ask for human approval before finalizing requirements, promoting a prototype, merging, changing company policy, or performing destructive operations.
